title: Figure 6: Ultracapacitor Use in a Forklift (lift truck operating profile)
description: Chart titled 'Lift truck operating profile' plotting power (kW, -10 to 35) versus time (hr, 0-2), sourced from General Hydrogen. Pink spikes show ultracapacitor output during peak power demands above a dashed fuel-cell output level near 13 kW, with regeneration and ultracapacitor input shown below zero. The caption states ultracaps provide energy storage on load descent and deliver peak power to lift heavy loads in fuel cell powered forklifts.
